summary.text: Day 4: 3rd Session - Manipur won by 3 wkts. MIZ 1st Innings made 183-10, Chinmay Sutar top-scoring with 35 off 72 balls; L Kishan Singha took 6 for 52. MNP 1st Innings made 251-10, Kangabam Priyojit Singh top-scoring with 87 off 166 balls; Khiangte Vanrotlinga took 5 for 66. MIZ 2nd Innings made 295-10, Chinmay Sutar top-scoring with 99 off 167 balls; L Kishan Singha took 4 for 88. MNP 2nd Innings made 228-7, Pheiroijam Jotin top-scoring with 105 off 143 balls; Khiangte Vanrotlinga took 3 for 42.
